summary: After a warmup, the source captures a bounded graph of full launches. The measured path replays the graph quotient and uses the selected launch dispatcher for remaining iterations, then synchronizes. Each selected final-sm86 width kernel traverses all nonzeros in each assigned CSR row and stores the result.
